judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the initial test-writing/planning phase and never implemented the actual feature. Specifically, `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (`ajv` dependency) are completely untouched, meaning all newly added tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Furthermore, none of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` or `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were added, and all required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) are missing. While `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` and the acceptance test structure align well with the problem statement, the submission leaves the test suite broken and the feature unimplemented.
